subject: CareVista residency attestation, VPC peering timeline & KMS boundaries
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@carevista.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: security@carevista.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Residency attestation and peering details for CareVista pilot

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week. Before we get the pilot spun up we need an explicit attestation that the pilot traffic and persistent artifacts will reside in the US region and that any private connectivity (VPC peering / PrivateLink) will be provisioned into our VPC without cross-region egress. Specifically, Security is asking for:

- A short attestation letter stating hosting is within the US (no EU/APAC egress).
- A high-level KMS partitioning diagram showing separation between CareVista keys and other tenants.
- A proposed peering window (dates/times) and an ops contact for the peering cutover.
- Copies or pointers to your SOC 2 summary and a SIG/CAIQ if you have one prefilled.

Can you confirm whether Redwood will sign the DPA addendum we shared and whether the peering requires on‑prem network changes on our side? We aim to start connectivity the week of Sep 7.

Appreciate a short response with attachments we can move to our procurement/security ticket.

Best,
Anika Rao
Head of Cloud Security | CareVista

[Attachment: CareVista_SIG_Request.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@carevista.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Residency attestation and peering details for CareVista pilot

Hi Anika — thanks for the clear checklist. High-level answers below and we can attach what you need: 

- Residency: Redwood can confirm the pilot will be served from our US-only cluster(s) and we will not route customer inference traffic through EU/APAC regions for this pilot. We will produce a one‑page attestation letter you can include in your audit packet.
- KMS: We maintain tenant-scoped KMS key partitions per customer; CareVista keys are logically separated and access controlled via RBAC and a customer-specific KMS policy. I will attach a boundary diagram.
- Peering: Peering is supported via private peering/PrivateLink into your VPC. We do not require cross-region peering. Proposed window: Sep 7–9. Our ops lead for the cutover will be irene_choi@redwood.com.
- Evidence: SOC 2 summary and a partially populated CAIQ are available — I will attach what we can share. Full SIG responses can be provided under an NDA if needed.

Attaching a quick region matrix and a draft VPC topology for your review. If that looks good IRENE and MARISSA will follow up with the runbook and KMS policy snippets.

Next step: can we lock Sep 8, 10–12 UTC as a tentative peering slot?

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Enterprise | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0124

[Attachments: redwood_region_matrix.xlsx (XLSX); redwood_vpc_topology.pdf (PDF)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Residency attestation and peering details for CareVista pilot

Diego / Marissa — looping in some operational detail we should include with Diego's packet to CareVista: 

- VPC peering runbook: step-by-step order of operations, IP ranges, failback plan, and expected downtime window. I'll attach the draft runbook and a checklist for the CareVista network team.
- KMS boundary: we'll create the customer KMS policy snippet (least-privileged) + diagram showing key separation across tenancy and HSM boundaries. Note that for on‑prem customers we offer optional HSM-backed keys; for this pilot we'll provide a KMS partition in the Redwood-managed HSM pool.
- Evidence packaging: SOC 2 summary (redacted) + CAIQ partial fill are fine for now; full SIG export requires a scoped request — recommend we offer to run the SIG export under an NDA and treat SIG answers as a follow-up deliverable.

I'll prepare:
1) vpc_peering_runbook_draft.pdf
2) kms_boundary_diagram.png
3) CAIQ-partial-filled.xlsx

Diego — confirm whether Legal needs any special language to approve the DPA you referenced.

-Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference

[Attachments: vpc_peering_runbook_draft.pdf (PDF)]

From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@carevista.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: security@carevista.com, procurement@carevista.com
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 07:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Residency attestation and peering details for CareVista pilot

Diego/Irene — thanks, this is helpful. A couple of clarifying items from Security & Procurement: 

1) Can you commit to the Sep 7–9 window now? We need to reserve engineers on our side.
2) We need the attestation as a signed PDF (letterhead) for our compliance evidence binder.
3) Procurement: will Redwood sign the standard DPA we attached and will pricing for the pilot remain as quoted in the MSA draft? Procurement is copying a sample redline.
4) Security would like the CAIQ prefilled where possible. If SIG requires an NDA, please share the NDA template and an expected turnaround.

If you can send the signed attestation and SOC/CBl (summary) by EOD Mon 24 Aug, we can greenlight scheduling.

Thanks,
Anika

[Attachment: CareVista_DPA_redline.docx (DOCX); CareVista_SIG_Request.xlsx (updated)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika.rao@carevista.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Residency attestation and peering details for CareVista pilot

Anika — great, thanks for the clear asks. Quick bullets and attached evidence: 

- Sep 7–9: confirmed. We will schedule the peering for Sep 8 01:00–03:00 UTC (tentative) and hold Sep 9 as the backup. Ops lead: irene_choi@redwood.com (Pager: +1 415 555 0189).
- Signed attestation: attached PDF on Redwood letterhead confirming US-only hosting for the CareVista pilot and no cross-region egress.
- KMS: attached kms_boundary_diagram.png and a short policy snippet included in the runbook PDF. Keys are tenant-scoped and provisioned in our managed HSM; export is prohibited by policy.
- Evidence: SOC2-summary.pdf and CAIQ-partial-filled.xlsx attached. For SIG export, we require an NDA — attached is our standard SIG/NDA template and an expected turnaround of 5 business days once executed. We can produce a scoped SIG export (redacted where necessary).
- DPA: Legal reviewed the redline; we can accept CareVista's standard DPA with the single change described in the attached DocuSign draft (minor data retention clause). Link to DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/CareVista-DPA-2026

Attachments included in this message: redwood_vpc_topology.pdf, kms_boundary_diagram.png, SOC2-summary.pdf, CAIQ-partial-filled.xlsx, redwood_region_matrix.xlsx, vpc_peering_runbook_draft.pdf, SIG_NDA_template.pdf, carevista_attestation_us_only.pdf

Next steps I propose:
- Please countersign the DPA via the DocuSign link (I circled the two fields procurement asked about).
- Security: confirm the peering slot (Sep 8 01:00–03:00 UTC) and share the primary network contact for the CareVista side.

Happy to hop on a short call if you want to run through the runbook.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Enterprise | Redwood Inference
Diego: +1 (415) 555-0124
